verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ הַ֭זִּיפִים בְּב֣וֹא לְשָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ דָ֝וִ֗ד הֲלֹ֥א מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ֣ תְדִינֵֽנִי׃ וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ haz·zî·p̄îm bə·ḇō·w lə·šā·’ūl way·yō·mə·rū ḏā·wiḏ hă·lō mis·tat·têr ‘im·mā·nū hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·šim·ḵā ṯə·ḏî·nê·nî ū·ḇiḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Maskil of David When the Ziphites went to Saul and said Is David not hiding among us Save me O God by Your name and vindicate me by Your might

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י אֱ֭לֹהִים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.literal: Hear my prayer O God listen to the words of my mouth

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî zā·rîm qā·mū ‘ā·lay wə·‘ā·rî·ṣîm biq·šū nap̄·šî lō śā·mū lə·neḡ·dām ’ĕ·lō·hîm se·lāh
verses.literal: For strangers rise up against me and ruthless men seek my life men with no regard . . . for God Selah

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.literal: Surely God is my helper the Lord is the sustainer of my soul
He will reward my enemies with evil In Your faithfulness destroy them

verses.original: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: bin·ḏā·ḇāh ’ez·bə·ḥāh- lāḵ ’ō·w·ḏeh šim·ḵā Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Freely I will sacrifice to You I will praise Your name O LORD for it is good

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִצִּילָ֑נִי מִכָּל־ צָ֭רָה עֵינִֽי׃ רָאֲתָ֥ה וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י
verses.transliteration: kî hiṣ·ṣî·lā·nî mik·kāl ṣā·rāh ‘ê·nî rā·’ă·ṯāh ū·ḇə·’ō·yə·ḇay
verses.literal: For He has delivered me from every trouble and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes
